saw_lines: Mattress buyers research for weeks, compare firmness and trial terms, then buy once and live with the choice for years.
So the sale is won or lost on trust, in the first line, before the offer is even read.
Your site shows 10,00,000+ customers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put that figure in the first line of your ads and open two with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: The site shows 10,00,000+ customers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Cold buyers have no reason to trust it. Put that figure in the first line of your ads and open two with a review quote.

5 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product shown. Buyers should not have to search for the mattress again. Point those ads to the product in its creative, such as Ergo, Ortho or Anti-Gravity.

27 of your 30 ads have run 60+ days and already work, yet none of the 3 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening, so they start cold. Build the next three on the oldest winner’s opening, swapping only the product.

Your 30 copy ads open with 26 different stories, and the biggest opens only 3 ads. Buyers never hear one story enough to recognize it. Build the next batch from the two strongest, the Ortho and spine support stories.

ads_1: Ortho and spine stories opening with the 10,00,000+ customer proof
